svg.title: AGENTFLOW SDLC · GOVERNED DELIVERY
svg.desc: One agent · nine role passes · the record outlives the session. Authority drops at review. Person gates bind to subjects, never to a phase number. Eight return routes are capped at two cycles before human escalation.
